The Hunt List

Made for the Ferrucho family · your Ikebukuro day, Sun Dec 20 · guide: Yuuki

Tell us what you're hunting for before the tour. We check real prices on Mercari, Japan's biggest second-hand marketplace, and send you actual listings. Once you approve, we buy it for you and hand it over in Ikebukuro on Dec 20.

The route

Four steps to X

  1. 1

    Send your list

    The item you want and the most you'd spend.

  2. 2

    Get real listings

    Links and photos of actual items for sale, with one total: item price plus domestic shipping.

  3. 3

    Approve and pay

    Pay by card through a payment link. Nothing is bought before you say yes.

  4. 4

    Collect it Dec 20

    We place the order and hand it to you on the tour day.

If something sells out, we tell you straight away. We never buy a substitute without asking.

Before you go

The honest part

  • Mercari is second-hand. Before buying, we always send you photos of the actual item.
  • No service fee for tour guests. You pay the item price plus domestic shipping only (usually ¥200-700).
  • Popular items sell fast. The sooner we get your list, the better your chances.
